line: A burnt hillside glows red, then waits under a blue night of ash; one small walker carries a sapling across it, and when the sun breaks over the ridge the light turns the dead trunks green again.
line_cn: 烧焦的山坡先是一片暗红，又在灰烬般的蓝夜里等待；一个小小的身影扛着树苗走过山脊，太阳破岭而出，光所到之处，枯干重新变绿。
uses: Before and after: renewal, recovery, hope
